evidence.reason: The fixture creates a temporary repository and commits at line 94 after setting only user.name and user.email, without ever disabling inherited commit.gpgSign. If a developer or CI has global commit.gpgSign=true, Git tries to sign with fixture@example.invalid, which normally has no matching signing key, so the baseline commit fails and DeployTests errors in setUp. Setting repository-local commit.gpgSign=false before the first commit is a small hermetic test fix, not a behavior change.
